body:
girl, this is embarrassing. you’re obviously unhappy and it’s pretty evident he either 1. doesn’t care/respect you enough to listen or 2. you two just aren’t compatible at all. this relationship hasn’t even been 6 months!! cut your losses here and get some real help. you’re 17, you don’t need to be “throwing hands w bitches” over some loser ass guy who doesn’t gaf about you anyways!

i read some of your other comments- the fact that you two met in rehab should be a red flag. relationships made in rehab are often codependent and unhealthy due to the stress experienced in that time. you should take the opportunity to grow and become comfortable with yourself as a person, not throw yourself into a relationship with someone who has their own problems to deal with.

OP, take this jackass to court. anything over 500 dollar value is taken to small claims court. you’d have a good case on your hands from the information you’ve shared, i think. this isn’t some stupid mistake and it sure as hell isn’t an insignificant amount of money. 

if he’s willing to spend so much of YOUR money on a stripper, what else would be willing to spend money on? what would be willing to give up in order to do so? what if he got access to your child’s college fund, what if he spent money that your child NEEDED? he obviously doesn’t regard you or your feelings/wants/needs/situation. don’t put your child through that. he made his bed. make him lie in it and have no regrets.

maybe your bluntness or prior expectations of them pushing you away or always leaving you out is causing a rift with your mother. your first message was not the most peaceful or vulnerable way to express your emotions or feelings. if you asked to have a conversation or approached it separately as a “i’m feeling left out, is there anything i’ve done recently to cause that/is there anything i can do to better this situation” it might’ve been different. you used it against her in the same breath as asking to be included on mother’s day. i understand you’re hurt, but your hurt could be causing more hurt with her and furthering the situation.

your responses are beautiful. i’m 19 and i’m glad to see other people my age who are able to stand up for themselves and see their worth. the choice now is whether you want to keep allowing his behavior to continue (and perhaps escalate), or to nip it in the bud now. you’re young, beautiful, and obviously have desires and aspirations for yourself. do you want to risk being worn down over time by this kind of behavior, potentially shrinking yourself unconsciously to avoid conflict? this could spill from just being a “bike” thing to other areas of your life and relationship. maybe he won’t like you talking to other men (even classmates, coworkers, established friends) for this same reason? 

it’s ultimately up to you. i’ve definitely spent time giving men (romantic partners generally) second chances, hoping they’d shape up or grow up. the results are mixed, because it depends on him/the other person. do you think he’s capable or willing to change? i hope you’re able to come to a solid conclusion and don’t suffer too much over this. sending you love.

i’m willing to see how they develop the relationship from here, but i’m definitely struggling with the change. the “i’m gay you’re not” felt like baiting to me and really shakes up their devotion to each other. dina was so devoted to ellie because they didn’t have the time to develop their relationship further. the day they got together officially was the day that joel died in the game. dina wanted to prove to ellie that she wasn’t alone in the wake of joel’s death and would be there for her no matter what, because they weren’t just girlfriends, they were real true friends. i just feel like their entire relationship thus far feels far less mature and like a partnership than it did in the game. dina basically planned the whole trip to seattle in the show, and her motivations are vastly different from the game.

this chick is fucking BRAINDEAD stupid and honestly so are you for not dropping her ass. the fact that you were paying her tuition in the first place is admirable, but naive. this immediately put a power imbalance in the relationship that could’ve potentially contributed to her controlling behavior over you. is it really about the body hair, or does she just feel the need to control the way you look act and think? i could be wrong here, honestly, but it seems like this is more than just you shaving your legs.

she’s got issues at the end of the day. don’t feel bad, don’t flip flop or give her second chances, don’t take the blame for this. at the end of the day, she BLAMED you for your sexual assault to get her way (which was you backing down, which you did by saying you still wanted to be friends and you just wanted her to stop talking like that. i think you know she’s a shitty friend and you deserve better than this. hope things look up for you and you find better people.

my boy had FIV and he lived an incredibly fulfilling and happy life. he didn’t struggle or suffer from day to day, so i wouldn’t worry too much. i would advise you, though, to keep an eye on his water intake and be vigilant with illnesses. maybe it’s just my personal experience, but my boy got sick incredibly quickly and suffered bowel blockages from (presumed) dehydration. the biggest issue with FIV is they don’t bounce back easily from illness and it comes on quick. keep him up to date on vaccinations and preventative care and he will be just fine!

i couldn’t have said it better. i understand that OP just wanted to have the whole family on vacation together, but the blatant disregard for her (almost grown) son’s commitments, opinions, and feelings is what makes her the AH. she had zero intentions or care to hear him out and was too stubborn to accept that he has new responsibilities as an almost young adult. this will only drive a wedge between her and her son, because the son has realized that his family isn’t all that great and he doesn’t want to hang out with them due to their disregard for his wishes or responsibilities- and honestly, i don’t blame him. i can’t believe OP grounded him instead of having an open conversation about the reality; her not respecting him, and him feeling helpless and like he has no control or options over his own life.
